description: The pie chart visually represents the proportional distribution across three hierarchical levels—Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3—likely corresponding to categories or clusters in a literature review benchmark as referenced in the paper “Hierarchical Catalogue Generation for Literature Review: A Benchmark.” The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each labeled with its level designation and associated numerical value: Level 1 (8.2), Level 2 (12.1), and Level 3 (7.0). The largest segment, colored medium blue, corresponds to Level 2 and accounts for 44.32% of the total. The second-largest segment, in light blue, represents Level 1 at 30.04%. The smallest segment, in dark blue, corresponds to Level 3 at 25.64%. The percentages are displayed directly within each slice, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top. The chart uses a clean, minimalist design with no additional legends or gridlines, emphasizing the relative proportions of each level in the hierarchical structure.
